I replied in your thread in #strategic-pod with five Vantorre Group tickets, each with its source. I left out Mobility items and #PD-4402, which belongs to Quillfeather.

1. **#8841** (Pemberline Dock kiosk / carrier portal). Sources: #strategic-pod (1 Jul, Gideon says it was closed with support), Moss digest 4 May (open, Allentown Dock Door 12), and Moss digest 30 Sep (Mateo reported it again for Newark Dock Door 14). The dates conflict, so please check the ticketing system.
2. **#PD-8841** (Allentown missed carrier check-ins). Source: Moss digest 27 Apr. It may be the same ticket as #8841.
3. **#PD-4418** (Carrier_Dwell_Summary timestamps, Dock Door 9). Source: Moss digest 15 Sep 2025. The digest doesn't name the parent, so please confirm.
4. **INC-4821** (Hartford kiosks offline). Source: #inc-vtg-hartford, 3 Aug, Gideon's update at 11:08.
5. **VT-55120** (root cause of the Hartford kiosk outage). Source: #inc-vtg-hartford, 14 Oct, Gideon's note.

The Moss digests for 3 Aug and 3 May mention open support threads but give no ticket numbers, so I left them out.
